usedFor: Zendesk Support holds tickets and customers, and Bolna places a call via “Make a Phone Call” after “Ticket Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Is Created” in Zendesk Support, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: It is pushed by Zendesk Support when a ticket opens, so the call can start without waiting on a schedule.

watchOut: “New Ticket Created or Updated” is polling and fires on updates too, so one ticket can trigger two calls.
